programme.title: Summer Camp
programme.desc: As children, Ginny (Kathy Bates), Nora (Diane Keaton) and Mary (Alfre Woodard) spent every summer together.When, after 50 years, there is an opportunity to meet again - at a summer camp meeting, the friends decide to take advantage of it, although with varying levels of enthusiasm.The least satisfied with her holidays is workaholic Nora, who feels best in her own company.Despite this, she and her friends take on new challenges, such as rafting or a rope park.Additionally, there, the woman meets her former lover, Stevie D (Eugene Levy).Thanks to him and the camp atmosphere, things start to change.

programme.title: IO
programme.desc: A donkey working in a circus performs with a young artist (Sandra Drzymalska).When he regains freedom thanks to activists, his wandering begins.During his journey, he experiences joy and pain.

programme.title: Unexpected Grace
programme.desc: Teenage Grace (Erica Tremblay) discovers a note written by a student looking for new friends.The girl decides to write back, which triggers a chain of events that change other people's lives.

programme.title: Barry 2
programme.desc: Further adventures of Barry Berkman, a former Marine and murderer who discovers his passion for acting.He is faced with the consequences of his previous decisions, including:murder of a friend.

programme.title: Barry 2
programme.sub-title: The Truth Has a Ring to It
programme.desc: Further adventures of Barry Berkman, a former Marine and murderer who discovers his passion for acting.He is faced with the consequences of his previous decisions, including:murder of a friend.

programme.title: A Picture Of Her
programme.desc: Beth (Rhiannon Fish) works as first mate on a fishing vessel.He goes ashore for a while to take care of his aunt (Samantha Ferris), who has broken her leg.During her daily shopping, photographer Jake (Tyler Hynes) secretly takes a photo of her choosing flowers.A freelancer sends a photograph of a stranger to a newspaper under a pseudonym.Some time later, Beth and Jake meet in person.They both turn out to be dog lovers, and over time they discover that they have a lot in common.The lovers' relationship is getting closer.Then Beth's photo appears on the cover of a magazine and goes viral, making her very popular.The woman wants to find the author, meanwhile Jake does not have the courage to confess the truth.

programme.title: The Last Vermeer
programme.desc: The Netherlands after World War II.The accountability of Nazi criminals and their accomplices continues.A Jew, Joseph Piller (Claes Bang), who fought in the resistance movement, is to deal with the case of stolen works of art.He accuses the eccentric painter Han van Meegeren (Guy Pearce) of collaboration, who hosted Germans at his home for hedonistic parties and sold them valuable paintings.The artist faces a death sentence.However, he claims that he traded in fakes he created.His exquisitely crafted fakes are indistinguishable from the originals.Although the evidence points to van Meegeren's guilt, and accepting his version would make the brilliant forger a national hero, Piller begins to believe him.Together with her assistant (Vicky Krieps), she tries to prove his innocence, putting her career and good name on the line.Based on facts, the extraordinary story of a Dutch painter and one of the best art forgers in history.It was based on the biography of Han van Meegeren by Jonathan Lopez.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Trolls are cheerful, singing and fabulously colorful creatures that live in a colorful forest.None of them have any idea what the world around them is like.Poppy displays their positive attitude the most.Her carefreeness and joy is shared by everyone, except Mruk.The troll believes that his brethren are in danger.These words come true when the village of nice creatures is found by their greatest enemies, the Bergens.All of Poppy's friends are kidnapped and she must set out to rescue them.She is accompanied by Mruk, who is reluctant to leave his house.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others: Magdalena Wasylik, Piotr Bajtlik, Ewa Konstancja Bułhak and Bartosz Obuchowicz.

programme.title: Infinitely Polar Bear
programme.desc: 1970s, Boston.Cam Stuart (Mark Ruffalo) suffers from bipolar disorder.Due to his illness, he had to be hospitalized and lost his job.One day, his wife, nurse Maggie (Zoe Saldana), accepts a scholarship to New York University.The MBA degree obtained there will help her find a well-paid job, thanks to which she will provide for her family and take care of her children's education.While staying in another city, her husband has to take care of his daughters - adolescent Amelia (Imogene Wolodarsky) and Faith (Ashley Aufderheide).He faces an exceptionally difficult task.Girls are often embarrassed by the behavior of their father, who keeps coming up with various unusual ideas.However, they help him face everyday challenges.

programme.title: Widow Clicquot
programme.desc: France at the turn of the 18th and 19th centuries.Twenty-year-old Barbe-Nicole Ponsardin (Haley Bennett) becomes the wife of François Clicquot (Tom Sturridge), a descendant of a family of winemakers.Although the marriage was arranged, they share great love.They also run a business together, and the woman is fascinated by her beloved's avant-garde approach to the methods of producing alcohol.Unfortunately, their happiness is disturbed by the man's sudden death.Despite the pain of losing her loved one, 27-year-old Barbe-Nicole, mother of Clémentine (Cecily Cleeve), is determined to manage the vineyard as a single woman, contrary to custom.She wants to continue implementing her husband's modern theories on viticulture and bottling techniques, and prepare her own blend of sparkling wine.To win, she must not be defeated by the capricious weather that threatens her harvest, the ruthless Jean-Remy Moët (Nicholas Farrell) who wants to deprive her of her business, or even the state that has the Napoleonic Code, which prohibits women from running a business.Based on the true story of a woman called the "grand lady of Champagne", who created the famous Veuve Clicquot brand and was one of the first businesswomen in the world.

programme.title: The Knick
programme.desc: New York, the first years of the 20th century.Brilliant surgeon Dr. John Thackery (Clive Owen) leads a brave team of young medics at Knickerbocker Hospital.The doctor introduces pioneering medical solutions while struggling with cocaine addiction.His team is making breakthroughs in medicine at a time when antibiotics do not yet exist and patient mortality is terrifyingly high.The group of distinguished medical staff includes, among others:protégé Everett Gallinger (Eric Johnson) and Algernon Edwards (Andre Holland), a promising surgeon from Europe who was included in the team against Thackery's wishes.The series is directed by Oscar winner Steven Soderbergh.

credits.actor: Dr. John W. Thackery - Clive Owen

programme.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programme.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programme.title: The Pitt
programme.desc: While in the hospital waiting room, Joseph Marino experiences severe convulsions.He is immediately admitted to the trauma surgery department.Trinity Santos argues with Frank Langdon over a patient's treatment plan.A young woman, Kristi, intends to have an abortion, but Dr. Heather Collins' ultrasound measurements indicate that her pregnancy is further along than the documents indicate.A doctor struggles with a serious moral dilemma.Langdon expertly performs retrograde intubation under Robinavitch's supervision.He says he recommended him for a prestigious scholarship.

programme.title: Euphoria
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programme.title: Rooster
programme.desc: Greg Russo (Steve Carell) has written a best-selling series of books, and readers identify him with his literary hero nicknamed Rooster.A famous writer comes to the university campus to support his daughter (Charly Clive) who is going through a marital crisis in a difficult moment.Her partner has just left her for a student, which everyone knows perfectly well.The situation is further complicated by scandals involving a woman who are the subject of gossip in the academic community.The father declares help, but his presence quickly reveals old conflicts and uncomfortable topics, instead of bringing the expected solution.

programme.title: Comeback 3
programme.desc: Valerie Cherish, a once popular television actress, rose to fame as a sitcom star.After many years, he wants to return to the small screen at all costs.He decides to take part in a new reality show.

programme.title: Holland
programme.desc: Nancy Vandergroot (Nicole Kidman) tries to fulfill her duties as a housewife perfectly.She lives a seemingly perfect life with her husband (Matthew Macfadyen) and son (Jude Hill) in the tulip-filled town of Holland, Michigan.He is an important member of a close-knit community.One day, the woman and her friend Dave (Gael García Bernal) discover a secret.They begin to suspect that nothing in their lives is what it seems.While searching for the dark truth, they expose themselves to danger.The film was directed by Mimi Cave, who made her debut in 2022 with the horror film "Fresh", well received by critics and viewers.

programme.title: Hell of a Summer
programme.desc: 24-year-old Jason Hochberg, together with his co-workers, is supposed to look after the youth camp participants.A serial killer appears in the area.Other staff members become the psychopath's target.

programme.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programme.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: Southport, a fishing community in North Carolina.Four friends - Helen, her boyfriend Barry, Julie and Ray - are driving home from celebrating the Fourth of July.Suddenly, a figure in a fisherman's cape appears on the road.Barry, who is under the influence of alcohol, hits the brake too late.The young people decide not to notify the police about the accident and throw the body into the water.Their plans are not changed even by the fact that the victim shows faint signs of life.After returning home, they cannot recover.Julie becomes depressed.A year after the tragic events, the girl receives a blood-curdling anonymous letter.It reads: "I know what you did last summer."Soon the nightmare begins.A box office hit of horror cinema, which turned out to be a career ticket for the actors playing the main roles.A slasher based on the 1973 novel, written by Kevin Williamson, who proved his ability to scare by writing the script for "Scream".

programme.title: Widow Clicquot
programme.desc: France at the turn of the 18th and 19th centuries.Twenty-year-old Barbe-Nicole Ponsardin (Haley Bennett) becomes the wife of François Clicquot (Tom Sturridge), a descendant of a family of winemakers.Although the marriage was arranged, they share great love.They also run a business together, and the woman is fascinated by her beloved's avant-garde approach to the methods of producing alcohol.Unfortunately, their happiness is disturbed by the man's sudden death.Despite the pain of losing her loved one, 27-year-old Barbe-Nicole, mother of Clémentine (Cecily Cleeve), is determined to manage the vineyard as a single woman, contrary to custom.She wants to continue implementing her husband's modern theories on viticulture and bottling techniques, and prepare her own blend of sparkling wine.To win, she must not be defeated by the capricious weather that threatens her harvest, the ruthless Jean-Remy Moët (Nicholas Farrell) who wants to deprive her of her business, or even the state that has the Napoleonic Code, which prohibits women from running a business.Based on the true story of a woman called the "grand lady of Champagne", who created the famous Veuve Clicquot brand and was one of the first businesswomen in the world.

programme.title: Christmas In The Spotlight
programme.desc: The singer and the football player start dating before Christmas.The public is following the development of their relationship with interest.The couple must decide whether the romance will turn into a lasting relationship.

programme.title: All That Breathes
programme.desc: The brothers Nadeem and Saud live in one of the most densely populated cities in the world - New Delhi.They both devoted themselves to protecting a species of bird characteristic of the local ecosystem - the black kite.These majestic predators descend on city streets in large numbers due to the very high level of air pollution.Nadeem and Saud spend their days and nights washing and treating the birds in their makeshift hospital located in the basement.After recovery, they help the black kites return to their natural habitat.The painting was awarded, among others:at the Sundance and Cannes festivals and nominated for an Oscar.

programme.title: King Charles III
programme.desc: After the death of Elizabeth II, her son Charles (Tim Pigott-Smith) takes over power in Great Britain.During his first meeting with Prime Minister Tristan Evans (Adam James), he learns about the draft law regulating the rights of the press, which has already been adopted by both the House of Commons and the House of Lords and is only awaiting the king's consent.Charles refuses to sign it, fearing that the new law will limit press freedom and allow the government to use censorship.Then, due to the prime minister's threat to introduce the law without royal consent, he dissolves parliament.Soon a wave of protests begins to sweep across the country, with the most violent taking place in London.The difficult situation at Buckingham Palace is not improved by a sex scandal involving the ruler's younger son, Prince Henry (Richard Goulding), related to the publication of compromising photos of him with his lover, Jessica (Tamara Lawrance).Charles's older son, William (Oliver Chris), and his wife Catherine (Charlotte Riley) also do not support the king.The young man accuses his father of causing the crisis and demands that he abdicate.A film version of Mike Bartlett's play of the same title.The author is also the author of the script for this production.

programme.title: Trolls World Tour
programme.desc: Poppy lives a peaceful life in her colorful and singing kingdom.One day he learns that beyond his borders there are other lands inhabited by trolls.Each of them has different rhythms.Just as she loves pop, the creatures inhabiting distant lands prefer rock, funk, techno, country and classical music.The curious queen, together with Mruk and other friends, sets off on a journey to meet and unite her kin.She will have to face the rebellious Barb, who wants to ensure that only rock rules in all lands.The continuation of the 2016 hit sticks to a proven recipe for success - a joyful, extremely colorful animation packed with great hits, showing the unifying power of music and the need for tolerance.The pandemic made the film go down in cinema history as the first high-budget production that went straight to VOD services, without a cinema premiere.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Magdalena Wasylik (Poppy), Piotr Bajtlik (Mruk) and Monika Węgiel-Jarocińska (Barb).

programme.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programme.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programme.title: The Front Runner
programme.desc: Senator Gary Hart (Hugh Jackman) is extremely popular, especially among younger voters.In 1988, he decided to run for the presidency of the United States for the second time.He is considered by many to be the favorite.However, unexpectedly, his extramarital relationship with Donna Rice (Sara Paxton) comes to light.The media is publicizing this case, and Hart's career is in question... The director and screenwriter of the film, Jason Reitman, was nominated for the Festival Award at the Toronto International Film Festival.

programme.title: The Knick
programme.desc: New York, the first years of the 20th century.Brilliant surgeon Dr. John Thackery (Clive Owen) leads a brave team of young medics at Knickerbocker Hospital.The doctor introduces pioneering medical solutions while struggling with cocaine addiction.His team is making breakthroughs in medicine at a time when antibiotics do not yet exist and patient mortality is terrifyingly high.The group of distinguished medical staff includes, among others:protégé Everett Gallinger (Eric Johnson) and Algernon Edwards (Andre Holland), a promising surgeon from Europe who was included in the team against Thackery's wishes.The series is directed by Oscar winner Steven Soderbergh.

programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club 5
programme.desc: Another installment of a fascinating series showing the fiercest clashes in the animal world.We will see extraordinary weapons and incredible tactics used by participants in the fierce fight for survival.The program presents recordings of the most powerful predators, such as lions, crocodiles and sharks, and tiny but surprisingly tough creatures, such as grasshoppers and brave insects.From the plains of Africa to the snowy wastes of North America, these are battlefields for territory, dominance and females.Thanks to elements of computer graphics, scenes presented in slow motion, close-ups and replays of key moments, viewers will not miss any detail.

programme.title: Abandoned Engineering: Season 13
programme.desc: There are many engineering projects in the world that have been abandoned for various reasons.The creators of the program present the stories of these structures and the people who created them.Behind each of them there is a fascinating and unique story.Viewers will discover the most spectacular examples of abandoned buildings from around the globe, including an underground Nazi base in France, designed to attack London, and a secret Japanese facility.We will find out why they were created and what led to their fall.

programme.title: Nazi Megastructures: Battle Ready
programme.desc: Profiles of engineers responsible for the construction of the most dangerous military facilities.Their works contributed to the technological revolution.The figures of Heinrich Himmler and Joseph Goebbels, who were completely devoted to Hitler, will also be introduced.The Führer assigned them the task of building the Nazi social machine.The program will also discuss the attack on the Soviet Union and the failure of total war tactics.You will be able to learn about the creation of the battleships Bismarck and Tirpitz, as well as the bunkers intended to protect submarines.In addition, the creators will talk about the conflict in the Pacific and the largest floating fortress armed with powerful guns.

programme.title: Iceland: Cold War Frontier

programme.title: Border Patrol
programme.desc: The series reports on the everyday life of dedicated New Zealand customs officers, working around the clock at the country's borders.Their tasks include, among others:catching transports of drugs and other illegal items, or intercepting objects containing potentially dangerous diseases.The program's heroes also monitor people arriving in the country to prevent individuals whose presence is not welcome there from entering its territory.Viewers will find out what technology customs officers use and how trained animals support them.

programme.title: Border Patrol

programme.title: Lost Treasures of The Maya
programme.desc: Albert Lin spent many months in the Guatemalan jungle in the company of an international team of scientists.He recorded material at twelve major archaeological sites.The researchers had at their disposal a LiDAR device that works similarly to an X-ray.It allowed the terrain to be scanned from the air.Thanks to this, a digital map was developed.A special application was also created showing the local landscape without forests.Therefore, there was no need to cut down the trees.Objects that were part of previously unknown cities were found, including pyramids and a fortified citadel.They also found the skeleton of the queen, the ruler's burial chamber with richly decorated ritual vessels, fragments of the skull of a sacrificed child, bas-reliefs, a stone altar, a painted vase, as well as dozens of statuettes and ceramic objects.The discoveries made allowed us to re-evaluate the current knowledge about the Mayan civilization.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.sub-title: Secrets of the Tower of Babel
programme.desc: Researchers begin excavations in places associated with events described in the Bible.Their discoveries shed new light on the most famous stories from the Holy Bible.

programme.title: Goulag: Une histoire soviétique
programme.desc: Millions of people were sent to forced labor camps in the USSR, including many Poles.Often their fate remained unknown.Not only criminals were sent there, but also political opponents and citizens who offended the system.Cheap labor in mines, quarries and logging was to support the economy.All documents have not yet been declassified.Wiedzę o łagrach można czerpać między innymi z literatury - "Archipelagu Gułag" Aleksandra Sołżenicyna czy "Innego świata" Gustawa Herlinga-Grudzińskiego.

programme.title: Lost Ships of WW2
programme.desc: Just before the end of World War II, the cruiser USS Indianapolis sank after being torpedoed by a Japanese submarine.About 900 sailors found themselves in the open ocean.Hungry and cold, they fought for survival for five days.Some fell victim to sharks.Over 300 people were rescued.Books have been written about the disaster, documentaries have been made, and in 2016, the war drama "The Last Mission of the USS Indianapolis" with Nicolas Cage in the main role was premiered.This time, viewers will learn not only the shocking story of the survivors, but also the circumstances of finding the legendary wreck.Epilogue of war history To accurately present the fate of the cruiser and its crew, documentarians used archival film materials, computer animations, expert statements and moving accounts of miraculously survived sailors, including Edgar "Ed" Harrell.Thanks to this, viewers can feel the horror of the events of 1945.The wreck of the USS Indianapolis rested at the bottom of the Philippine Sea at a depth of over 5.5 km.Only 72 years after the tragedy, members of Paul Allen's expedition managed to locate it.Thanks to this, it was possible to write an epilogue to the story about the greatest maritime disaster in the history of the United States Navy.

They decide to start robbing banks.

When he's not dodging his followers or being scolded by his shrill mother, the hapless Brian has to contend with the pompous Pontius Pilate and acronym-obsessed members of a separatist movement. Rife with Monty Python's signature absurdity, the tale finds Brian's life paralleling Biblical lore, albeit with many more laughs.

programme.title: The Commitments
programme.desc: Jimmy Rabbitte is a would-be music business wheeler and dealer, and he's decided what Dublin needs is a top-shelf soul band. However, top-shelf soul musicians are hard to find in Dublin, so he has to make do with what he can find. Before long, the band, called the Commitments, is packing them in at local clubs. Do they have what it takes to make the big time?

We follow them over three years and eight parties, as they navigate countless complications and each experience their own emotional highs and lows in love.

programme.title: I Am Number Four
programme.desc: John Smith (Alex Pettyfer) seems like an ordinary teenager, but he is an alien on the run from merciless enemies hunting him and the eight others like him. Always changing his identity and moving to different towns with his guardian, Henri (Timothy Olyphant), John has no real past and no true home. However, in the small Ohio town where he now lives, he discovers love, powerful new abilities, and a connection to others of his kind.

As these extraordinary events unfold, it becomes increasingly clear that a force of incredible magnitude has arrived; its mission: total annihilation over the Fourth of July weekend. The last hope to stop the destruction is an unlikely group of people united by fate and unimaginable circumstances.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin discovers that Samantha has been entertaining a guest each morning after he leaves for work. the guest is ten year old Marshall Burns. Marshall's mother is a widow, whose over-protectiveness has robbed Marshall of all his self-confidence. Darrin tells Samantha that she has no right to interfere with Mrs. Burns' upbringing of her son. Despite Marshall's belief that he is no good at anything, Samantha takes him to a Junior League ball game. Marshall has never been able to make the team. Floyd Kravitz, nephew of Gladys Kravitz, is the star player. With a little witchery on Samantha's part, Marshall becomes a triple threat. When his mother, fearful that he may be inured, forbids him to play, Marshall runs away from home. Samantha and Darrin drive Mrs. Burns to the ball field. There, Marshall, in his own right, has continued to star. How-ever, when Marshall gets into a tight spot, Darrin forbids Samantha from interfering. Marshall makes it on his own. Proud of her son, Mrs. Burns is not unhappy when Coach Gribben suggests that he visit the Burns home to give Marshall some extra coaching.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha, her friends, Bertha and Mary, and her Aunt Clara, all witches, decide to change the popular conception of witches into a more flattering image. Their opportunity arises when Darrin, an ad man, is assigned to devise a trademark for a new type of Halloween candy. Mr. Brinkman, the promoter of the candy, wants the trademark to show a traditional witch. Darrin at first agrees, but when he sees how upset Samantha becomes, he decides to present a beautiful witch. Mr. Brinkman objects, but Darrin refuses to yield. Con-sequently, he is fired. The witches decide to practice some of their pranks on Mr. Brinkman. As a topper, they transform him into an ugly old witch. Mr. Brinkman finally admits that his idea of witches is wrong. He agrees to use a glamorous witch for his trademark. Samantha wins her point, and Darrin wins back his job.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Teenager Liza Randall interviews Darrin about his career in advertising for a school newspaper. After Darrin takes Liza to the agency on Saturday, Liza's jealous boy friend, Marvin "Monster" Grogan, visits Samantha. Monster, a football star, wants to batter Darrin. Samantha, stuffing Monster with food, explains the innocence of Darrin and Lisa's relationship, although she knows Liza is more than interested in Darrin. At the office, Liza pours drinks. Liza and Darrin are doused when Darrin tries to take the drink away from her. Darrin escapes an awkward situation when boss Larry Tate arrives with two prospective clients . Meanwhile, Monster takes a romantic interest in Samantha. Darrin and Liza arrive, reeking of liquor. Darrin accuses Samantha of playing up to Monster. Samantha taunts him about Liza. However, when Monster winds up to clout Darrin, he bruises his hands on the invisible shield Samantha has created. When Liza slaps Darrin, however, Samantha lets him get the full force of the blow. Later Samantha removes her own protective shield when Darrin tries to make up.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin's workload piles sky-high when Larry Tate and his wife Louise fly to Paris to cover the fashion showings- for a client. Samantha spends most of the time alone playing solitaire. She accepts Endora's invitation to fly to Paris, without a plane, of course, for lunch. In Paris, Samantha and Endora run into the Tates. Larry is surprised, phones Darrin that Samantha and her mother are in Paris with them. Samantha returns home immediately. Darrin tells Samantha their marriage is a mistake, since he has taken her away from all the high living she seems to love. Although Samantha tries to convinces Darrin that he is wrong, she angrily leaves, and returns to Paris. Larry Tate tells Darrin Samantha is lonesome for him. Darrin decides to follow her to Paris. After several unsuccessful tries, Samantha gets on Darrin's plane, and they arrive in Paris together.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Endora tells Samantha that Maurice, her father, is coming to visit. Endora warns Samantha that Maurice will be furious when he learns his daughter has married a mortal. Samantha, determined to stand up to her father, gets Darrin to stay in town on the night Maurice calls. Samantha tells Maurice that her husband is in Washington. The conversation about Darrin proceeds nicely until Maurice surmises Darrin is a mortal. Meanwhile, Darrin, who has been drinking with Larry Tate, phones Samantha and tells her he is coming home. When Darrin arrives, Maurice's fury hits its peak. Al-though Maurice admires Darrin's courage in facing up to him, he makes him disappear. Samantha, expressing her love for Darrin, pleads with Maurice to bring him back. Even Endora joins in Samantha's pleas. Although he tells them it will be extremely difficult, Maurice makes Darrin reappear. Before leaving, Maurice joins his family in a champagne toast. Im-pressed by the rare vintage, Maurice feels Darrin might be one of them after all.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: It Takes One To Know One
programme.desc: When Darrin starts searching for a "Miss Jasmine" for his firm's perfume account, Endora seizes the opportunity to sew doubt in Samantha's mind about her husband's loyalty. The search for a beautiful model ends when Jannine Fleur arrives. Both Larry and Darrin agree that Jannine is "Miss Jasmine." Samantha learns that Jannine is a witch whom Endora has asked to captivate Darrin. Samantha warns Jannine to keel away from Darrin. Jannine, intrigued, keeps on with her original assign-ment. Darrin uses Larry Tate as his chaperone to keep him from becoming involved with Jannine. Darrin and Larry go to Jannine's apartment to discuss details of the "Miss Jasmine" campaign. Jannine doctors the drinks. Larry falls asleep and Darrin becomes amorous. Just as Darrin starts to kiss Jannine, Samantha uses her witchcraft, and Darrin appears to Jannine as a large ugly fish. When the campaign is completed, Samantha turns the picture of "Miss Jasmine" into a caricature of Jannine.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Larry and Louise Tate have been married for sixteen years and have no children. Louise asks Samantha to go with her to an obstetrician as tests have shown she is going to be a mother. Louise tells Samantha she is afraid to tell Larry since she believes he hates children. Larry, visiting his dentist at the medical center, sees Louise and Samantha enter the obstetrician's office. Thinking Samantha is going to have a baby, he tells Darrin, but cautions him not to say anything until Samantha tells him. In a reverie, Darrin visualizes his children as little witches. He comes to with a sinking feeling. Samantha invites the Tates to dinner. Both Larry and Darrin hover over Samantha, warning her not to exert herself. Louise is all but forgotten, but makes several unsuccessful attempts to tell Larry that he is to be a father. Finally, Samantha tells Larry. He is overjoyed. Although Darrin doesn't tell Samantha about his reverie, he is reassured when she tells him she hopes they have a child who looks just like him.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha's friend, Gertrude, a nice, plain-looking girl expresses her envy of the happiness Samantha has found in marriage. Although Darrin tries to avoid getting mixed up in matchmaking, Samantha persuades him to bring Kermit, a handsome artist, home to dinner to meet Gertrude. Kermit falls for Gertrude. Although Samantha will mot admit it, Darrin suspects Gertrude is a witch and tries to break up her romance with Kermit. Darrin arranges a meeting at a nightspot for Kermit with Susan, a former girl friend. There, Samantha uses witchcraft to get Susan into an argument with Kermit. Susan storms out, unable to recall what has happened. When Gertrude arrives, according to Samantha's plan, Kermit proposes to her.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin's parents pay their first visit to the Stephens home, Darrin's mother, Phyllis, hopes to find that his wife is a poor housekeeper. Soon after, Samantha's Aunt Clara comes down the chimney for an unexpected visit. Darrin is worried about the kind of impression Aunt Clara will make on his parents, but agrees with Samantha that they must make Aunt Clara feel welcome. Determined to help Samantha make a hit with her in-laws, Aunt Clara uses her witchcraft to whip up a feast for dinner. Thinking that Samantha has done the cooking, Phyllis becomes quite upset. Although Samantha warns him to be tactful, Darrin makes Aunt Clara feel she is not wanted. After Aunt Clara's de-parture, Samantha gets into an argument with Darrin, during which Phyllis learns Aunt Clara cooked the dinner. When Samantha admits she is not a good housekeeper, Phyllis, who felt she was being pushed aside, knows she is going to love her daughter-in-law. Darrin persuades Aunt Clare to return and the evening ends happily for all.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Seven year old Tommy, who lives in an orphanage, is happy to spend Christmas with Gladys and Abner Kravitz. Six year old Michael, also an orphan, derides Tommy's belief is Santa Claus. When Samantha and Darrin bring him home for the holidays, their efforts to get Michael to share in the festivities of the season fail. After Michael admits he would believe in Santa Claus if he really existed, Samantha takes Michael and Darrin on her broomstick to the North Pole, where Michael meets Santa Claus. Later, back at home Darrin and Michael awake. Although both feel they have dreamed the trip, Michael now believes in Santa Claus. Gladys overhears Michael tell Tommy he has met Santa Claus. When she tries to pin Tommy down, he denies that Michael had ever mentioned it. Mrs. Grange, the director of the orphanage, comes to the Stephens home with George and Sarah Johnson. At the Kravitz home, both Gladys and Abner, who are about to return Tommy to the orphanage, express their wish to have someone like Tommy permanently. When Michael leaves with Mr. and Mrs. Johnson, Samantha and Darrin know Michael has found two loving parents.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: The members of the Hospital Fund Auxiliary appoint Samantha Entertainment Chairman for the group's bazaar. Limited to spending fifty dollars, Samantha hires Zeno, a broken down magician who has taken to drink. Because of this, his assistant, Roxie Ames, has left the act. Using her gift of magic, Samantha makes Zeno the hit of the show. As a result, Zeno gets a job on TV. Zeno pleads with Samantha to help him. Assisted by Samantha, Zeno runs through a very successful rehearsal. Just before the show goes on the air, Roxie appears and injects herself into the act. Hogging the show, Roxie kills Zeno' s act and his con-fidence. She admits she returned just to get a regular spot on TV herself. Samantha turns Roxie into a comic prop for Zeno. After Zeno's successful performance, Darrin tells Samantha that his client has booked Zeno for the next thirteen weeks. Darrin attempts some magic on his own. When he succeeds, he is not certain whether his skill or Samantha's is responsible.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska has been wandering the world for many years and looking for interesting people who share their unique stories with her.The traveler not only talks about their everyday lives, but also raises important social issues.In the tenth season of the program he will visit, among others:Spitsbergen - the largest island of the Svalbard archipelago, where it is night for a quarter of the year.He will also reach out to the Wodaabe community living in Chad, and in El Salvador he will tackle the difficult issue of restrictive anti-abortion regulations. Martyna Wojciechowska breaks stereotypes.In the Wodaabe community of Chad, men court women.For this reason, they attach great importance to their appearance.They put on their best clothes and do their makeup.Their chosen ones are only supposed to observe and then decide.The best place to look for a husband is the Gerewol Festival.The episode's heroine, Fatima, chose Haire last year.According to tradition, their wedding should take place on the anniversary of the happy event.A few months ago, the woman gave birth to a daughter.They only see each other in secret, because only such meetings are allowed.A man can have several wives, but he must pay appropriately for a good partner.Among the Wodaabe, the greatest wealth is cows.Haire's parents gave five cows and several million Central African francs for Fatima.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska has been wandering the world for many years and looking for interesting people who share their unique stories with her.The traveler not only talks about their everyday lives, but also raises important social issues.In the tenth season of the program he will visit, among others:Spitsbergen - the largest island of the Svalbard archipelago, where it is night for a quarter of the year.He will also reach out to the Wodaabe community living in Chad, and in El Salvador he will tackle the difficult issue of restrictive anti-abortion regulations. Martyna Wojciechowska spent six hundred and fifty days traveling, during which she visited fifty countries.This is how eighty episodes of the program were created.Over the ten years of the series, she has made many new friends, and many of the characters still hold a special place in her heart.They include Kabula - an albino girl from Tanzania.Thanks to the money collected by viewers and the "Between Heaven and Earth" foundation, she was able to fulfill her dreams.She started studying at a private school in Mwanza.Now he is doing everything he can to become a lawyer and defend the rights of people with albinism.She spent her last holidays in Poland, with Martyna Wojciechowska.Viewers will see how this first visit went.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on a fascinating journey to learn about different aspects of the lives of women living in distant corners of the world.Some of the points of the route in this edition will be India, Senegal, South Korea, South Africa, Israel and Mexico.The program participants will talk about their everyday lives and reveal intimate secrets to the traveler.Some of them will be truly moving.This season, the journalist will look at how the Orthodox Jewish community functions on a daily basis and how they celebrate the joyful holiday of Purim.He will visit a nursing home for women who were once involved in prostitution.Although this profession is legal in Mexico, women are not entitled to any benefits.The traveler will also meet teenage Karolina, who works almost 24 hours a day at a garbage dump, and in South Africa she will meet a girl who dives with sharks.These are just some of the many amazing experiences that await Martyna Wojciechowska Martyna Wojciechowska visits South Korea, a country that has one of the lowest fertility rates in the world.According to research, as much as 90 percentmen and 80 percentwomen between 25 and 30 are single.Women fear that marriage and pregnancy will stand in the way of their advancement at work and will be a reason for discrimination.On the other hand, South Korea is a conservative country and almost every woman wants to get married.For this reason, the business of solo weddings is booming here.It turns out that young Korean women do not even need a partner to fulfill their dreams of a white dress and a veil.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places The host visits the Dixie Dude Ranch, which was created for tourists.You can ride a horse here, feel like a resident of the prairie and experience the cowboy life.There are dozens of similar places in Texas.Marcin Prokop will try to find out whether they show the truth about the everyday life of the inhabitants of this part of America.There will also be a Polish accent.In the nearby town of Bandera there is a church built by Poles, where the parish priest is an emigrant from Silesia.Finally, a meeting with Ezekiel Mitchell, a professional bull rider, who will tell the host where his fascination with this dangerous sport comes from.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Boston is a city of great historical and scientific importance.This is where prestigious universities such as Harvard and MIT are located, as well as the headquarters of Boston Dynamics, known for creating humanoid robots.Although the city is associated with the American Revolution, it also has lesser-known stories.Marcin will meet a guide who will talk about the first settlers and explain events such as the flooding of the city by molasses in the early 20th century, the smell of which can still be felt on hot days.Marcin will also talk to Walter Robinson from the Boston Globe about the famous journalistic investigation presented in the film "Spotlight", which revealed a scandal in the local archdiocese, affecting the city and the world.In addition, the host will take viewers to Salem, a town known for its witch trials from three hundred years ago.Today, the Salem witches attract tourists and are one of the area's main attractions.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Horror is currently one of the most profitable genres in literature and film.Novels such as "Carrie", "Salem's Salem" and "The Shining" are considered horror classics.Their author, Stephen King, sets most of his stories in the quiet corners of Maine.Marcin Prokop visits King's hometown to understand how the environment in which the writer grew up influenced his extraordinary ability to create terrifying stories.These places are characterized by beautiful nature and peace, which attracts tourists away from the hustle and bustle of the city, creating an image of an American idyll.Marcin wants to discover what in this setting could have inspired King to write and whether the town of Derry, famous for his works, really exists under a different name.

programme.desc: Every year, passengers traveling around the world lose millions of pieces of luggage.Many of them do not come forward to collect their lost items.Smart Billy Leroy, self-confident Mark Meyer and eccentric husband and wife Laurence and Sally Martin turned lost suitcases into a source of profit.Each of them visits auctions where unclaimed goods, items seized by the police or left at airports are auctioned.Relying on experience and intuition, they try to gain possession of the treasures hidden in the bags.It turns out that they can earn thousands of dollars in this not very complicated way.

programme.title: Unobvious places
programme.desc: Katarzyna Jaroszyńska visits house owners who live in areas with no neighbors.Among the inhabitants of this type of solitude is Szymon, who lives in a mountainous area covered with ferns.Its concrete oasis, equipped with large windows providing beautiful views, is located above the ground, above the ground line.Another participant of the program, the thrifty Kamil, lives in a spacious building on the water.His 200 sq m apartment is one of the first Polish water houses.Bartek, a lover of silence, peace and offline life, lives in solitude surrounded by a forest.

programme.title: Unobvious places
programme.desc: This time, the host visits owners of ancient houses with their own history.The new hosts renovated these buildings and created their own places on the land where other families lived long ago.An international couple, Ania and Paul, are passionate about archives and monuments.They live in a two-century-old weaver's house, located in a charming land of extinct volcanoes.Kasia and Mariusz's love for the mountainous areas turned out to be stronger than their attachment to life in the capital.So they decided to permanently live in an 80-year-old farm at the very top of Paproć Hill.Kasia and Darek live in a dreamy old mill near Kazimierz Dolny.They preserved its historical character, adding only the necessary modernizations.

programme.title: Unobvious places
programme.desc: Konrad decided to use second-hand elements to build his house, such as old doors and windows.In turn, the architect Magda is interested in ecological construction.The heroine will present her favorite project, i.e. the metamorphosis of an old barn into a residential house.Karolina and Janusz have always dreamed of having their own plot of land with a nice view.Finally, they managed to fulfill this wish by purchasing land in Dobczyce, Lesser Poland.Due to the fact that they used almost the entire budget to buy the land, they had to find a way to build the estate for only PLN 6,000.zlotys.

programme.title: Unobvious places

programme.desc: Josh Gates sets out to find the yeti, a legendary half-man, half-ape creature that lives high in the Himalayas.During this expedition, the traveler talks to world-famous researchers.

programme.title: Man v Food 2
programme.desc: Adam sets off on a journey across the United States to take part in subsequent rounds of timed eating competitions.Adam will take on Badass Burrito in Las Vegas and a 106-centimetre pizza in San Antonio.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places The host visits the Dixie Dude Ranch, which was created for tourists.You can ride a horse here, feel like a resident of the prairie and experience the cowboy life.There are dozens of similar places in Texas.Marcin Prokop will try to find out whether they show the truth about the everyday life of the inhabitants of this part of America.There will also be a Polish accent.In the nearby town of Bandera there is a church built by Poles, where the parish priest is an emigrant from Silesia.Finally, a meeting with Ezekiel Mitchell, a professional bull rider, who will tell the host where his fascination with this dangerous sport comes from.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places Gold diggers still inhabit Colorado.One of them is Kevin Singel, who in a conversation with Marcin Prokop will reveal whether the stories about overnight fortunes are true and how much the largest piece of precious metal he has found is worth.The host will also visit the mine of Jesse Patterson, who is considered a legend among the local gold prospectors.The man will try to teach Marcin a professional technique for rinsing stones and will talk about what he learned from the Poles he met many years ago.Finally, on the outskirts of Denver, Marcin will discover a real treasure - an extraordinary store resembling a museum of the 1980s.This visit will turn out to be a real journey back in time.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places In this episode, Marcin Prokop sets off on a journey to Silicon Valley.But first, he will visit Sausalito, a city called the Venice of America.In this unique place, houses are built on the water, and residents are separated from the bustling San Francisco by a trip over the Golden Gate Bridge.However, in the heart of Silicon Valley there is Stanford University.This prestigious university counts among its graduates, among others, Elon Musk.This is where Han will tell the host about how to create your own company in the center of American technological thought.Marcin Prokop will also meet Jakub Pachocki.This will be a great opportunity to ask one of the creators of ChatGPT a few questions generated by this tool.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places Opened in 1894, Huntsville Prison is an institution where over 580 people lost their lives.Executions of convicts were carried out using an electric chair, which can now be seen as a museum exhibit.David Stacks, a former prison guard, will talk about working there and the emotions that accompany meetings with the most dangerous criminals in America.Jimi Willet, former prison warden and execution supervisor, will reveal whether he ever managed to get used to death.Marcin will also ask him about the impact his job has on his family life.

programme.title: Secrets of the wrecks of the Baltic Sea
programme.desc: Franken is a German mechanically driven tanker sunk near Hel by Soviet aviation during World War II - on April 8, 1945.The wreck hides a story of great passion and, at the same time, great tragedy.Diving on it is demanding because you have to go below 40 meters, so partial decompression is necessary.In addition to the entire list of victims that Franken had when it sank in 1945, three divers should be added - a Czech and two Poles.The team places a symbolic expression of memory of the dead underwater, a monument that rests on the surface of one of the most dangerous wreck diving facilities.

programme.title: Secrets of the wrecks of the Baltic Sea
programme.desc: The controversial destruction of a historic ship which, against the will of the inhabitants of Rostock, Germany, was sold for scrap.Georg Büchner - a luxury liner lost buoyancy while being towed to the shipyard in Klaipeda, Lithuania, and went to the bottom.Former passenger Freddy Korthoudet tells us what an exclusive passenger ship the Büchner, once called the Charlesville, was.Tomek Stachura, together with a team of divers and a German journalist and enthusiast of the history of this machine, Merlin Franke, are trying to determine the actual course of events on May 30, 2013.It helps, among others:Frederik Janssens, Belgian souvenir collector.Divers descend to the wreck, which sank relatively recently and has not yet been destroyed by the sea.

programme.title: Men, Women, Wild

programme.title: Marooned with Ed Stafford 2
programme.desc: Former British Army captain and experienced traveler Ed Stafford continues to overcome new challenges.He became known to viewers as a steadfast man who is able to cope with any extreme situation.So far, among others:he underwent a test of survival for 60 days on one of the uninhabited islands of Fiji, where he had no supplies of food, clothing or necessary equipment.Moreover, he walked the trail leading along the Amazon River, which earned him a place in history and the Guinness Book of Records.In the next series of the program "Ed Stafford Beyond Civilization", the traveler once again sets off to the most hostile corners of the world, including the Gobi Desert in Mongolia and the crocodile-infested Guatemalan jungle.

programme.title: Champagne Charlie
programme.desc: This is the tale of Charles Heidsieck who introduced Champagne to the American market right before the Civil War. Though a hesitant French spy, he ends up caught and held in a Union prison. The story also features two love stories (since, well, he's French) and some conflicts with his uncle over who gets to run the family vineyard. The tension comes from the fact that his dad married his mom, who was also his uncle's love interest.

programme.title: Zulu Dawn
programme.desc: In 1879 South Africa, British Cape Colony administrators seek to crush the Zulus, viewing them as an obstacle to their colonial ambitions. To provoke war, they issue King Cetshwayo an impossible ultimatum, confident their rifles and artillery will ensure an easy victory. But as Lord Chelmsford’s forces chase an unseen foe, they discover near Isandlwana how gravely they’ve underestimated the Zulu nation’s skill and strength.

programme.title: The Perfect Cheerleader
programme.desc: When Cassie Talbot gets into the college of her dreams and makes the cheerleading squad, she feels her whole world is changing, for the better! She has new friends, cheerleading is exciting, things are good... But when a handsome man comes into her life, she slowly uncovers a dark secret. And when a fellow cheerleader disappears, and is found dead under suspicious circumstances, it unlocks a deadly conspiracy, putting her life in grave danger

programme.title: Cheer for your Life
programme.desc: A high school girl feels defeated during a rough Cheerleader Initiation Week, but her dreams aren’t the only thing at stake when another cheerleader ends up dead.

programme.title: Inside Out
programme.desc: Three decades after WWII ended, a group of ex-GIs and German soldiers are aiming to recover Nazi treasure stashed away in the Soviet-controlled part of East Germany. Only a Nazi war criminal, who is behind bars, knows the precise spot where it's hidden.

programme.title: Charade
